subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the guard assertions are synchronized, should these privileged action updates remain one grouped dependency PR or be split into smaller security-sensitive groups?
rationale: The upstream commits are verified and the integration defects are mechanical, but the final grouping choice affects reviewability and rollback scope for token, Codex, CodeQL, and publishing automation.

options.title: Keep the verified group
options.body: Retain the grouped update after resolving current-main conflicts, synchronizing all guards, and obtaining exact-head workflow validation.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate token-minting, Codex, CodeQL, and Docker publishing action updates to reduce review and rollback scope.

recommendation.title: Keep the verified group
recommendation.body: Retain the grouped update after resolving current-main conflicts, synchronizing all guards, and obtaining exact-head workflow validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the author of the affected workflow guard invariants and recent CI hardening changes.
